items.title: AI for Predictive Weather Analysis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AI for Predictive Weather Analysis (PDF 117, printed 113).

blocks.text: AI systems mausam ka data analyze kar ke barish, khushk-sali (drought) ya darja hararat ke patterns ka andaza laga sakte hain. Yeh andaze kisanon ko apne kaam ki mansooba bandi aur faslon ko mausam ke nuqsan se bachane mein madad dete hain, jis se paidawar behtar aur nuqsan kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: AI mausam ke data se kin cheezon ka andaza lagati hai aur is ka kisan ko kya faida hai?
blocks.explanation: Barish, khushk saali (drought) ya darja hararat ke patterns. Kisan apne kaam ki planning kar ke faslon ko mausam ke nuqsan se bacha sakte hain: behtar paidawar, kam nuqsan.

items: AI weather prediction: barish, drought, darja hararat; behtar planning.
